description: (tikajs-mic4) A binary file named .wpd with no WordPerfect header (the corpus's wp_mac1.wpd, a Mac WordPerfect 3 file): Tika 4.2.0 detects application/vnd.wordperfect with no version and its EmptyParser returns no content and no error; its WordPerfectParser is registered for the versions only. ripstream threw 'Not a WordPerfect document'. The 20 bytes are synthetic.
